text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. The purpose of this report is to obtain approval to prohibit parking from 8:30 a.m. to 2:30 p.m., Monday to Friday on the west side of Ricardo Road, from Burr Avenue to the south limit of the road. The proposed parking prohibition is being requested by area residents, in consultation with staff and the Ward Councillor, to address excessive parking on Ricardo Road.
Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Prohibited parking from 8:30 a.m. to 2:30 p.m., Monday to Friday on the west side of Ricardo Road, between Burr Avenue and the south limit of the road.
